shopify.title: Rhea crossbody bag
shopify.descriptionHtml:
Rhea pairs a horizontal silhouette with a warm reddish-brown finish. Visible stitching gives the exterior definition, while internal pockets help separate the small things you reach for throughout the day.

  • Horizontal silhouette
  • Internal phone and document pockets
  • Internal zippered pocket

specifications.care: General guidance for the leather exterior, not product-specific manufacturer instructions. Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight, heaters and damp storage. If wet, let the leather dry naturally away from heat. Do not machine wash or use household cleaners. Identify the finish before using a treatment; use only a suitable product and test an unseen area first. For stains or an unknown finish, consult a leather-care specialist. Follow any instructions supplied with your bag.
